title: PumpMeme
tagline: A decentralized meme asset launch platform built on Uniswap V4, designed to empower creators and communities to quickly launch and trade meme assets.
description:
PumpMeme is a meme asset launch platform built on Uniswap V4, enabling users to freely buy and sell meme assets before their official launch. Meme prices are determined by a virtual curve mechanism. Once a predefined purchase volume and transaction threshold are reached, the meme asset is automatically launched into a Uniswap V2 liquidity pool.

To incentivize trading activity within the V4 pools, PumpMeme integrates a unique reward system. Upon launch, a portion of the funds raised is donated to the pool with the highest trading volume, further encouraging active participation and boosting overall liquidity. This innovative approach ensures a vibrant and dynamic trading ecosystem for meme assets.
how_its_made:
Building PumpMeme: The Technical Breakdown

PumpMeme leverages Uniswap V4 as the foundation for its pre-launch trading mechanics. The virtual curve mechanism is implemented to dynamically determine meme asset prices based on trading activity, allowing users to interact with the platform in a fair and decentralized manner. Once the purchase volume and transaction thresholds are met, the system triggers an automatic deployment of the meme asset to a Uniswap V2 liquidity pool, ensuring seamless integration into the DeFi ecosystem.

Technologies Used:
Solidity: Core smart contracts were developed to handle the virtual curve pricing, thresholds for deployment, and fund distribution mechanics.
Uniswap V4 and V2 Protocols: Uniswap V4 was used for its advanced features like custom hooks and efficient pool design, while Uniswap V2 was chosen for its established liquidity and user base post-launch.

Integration and Benefits:
Uniswap V4 Hooks: Custom hooks allowed us to track swap count and donate to the pool.
Transaction Incentive Mechanism: By redistributing part of the funds to the most active V4 pools upon launch, we created a gamified incentive structure that promotes trading activity.

Hacky Highlights:
These innovations make PumpMeme a cutting-edge platform for meme asset trading, seamlessly blending technology with community-driven incentives.
